subject: How to use renderText and data.frame to create table in Shiny?

messages.author: 0dbf1fac5e1da4c1
messages.subject: How to use renderText and data.frame to create table in Shiny?
parts:
Hi everyone,
 
Thanks ahead of time to anyone who takes the time to help out an R newby!
 
I'm trying to use renderText and data.frame to create a highly customized HTML data table for a Shiny application. I've already exhausted all efforts with renderTable and renderDataTable - I'm not satisfied with the format and other constraints, so I'd like to avoid such solutions. I would like to produce the following table (simple example) for a Shiny application:
                     Values1       Values2
1/31/2015         100              90
2/28/2015         110              85
....
 
My ui.R line looks like this:
 
mainPanel(
                     textOutput("table1")
                 )
 
And my server.R looks like this:
 
shinyServer(function(input, output) { 
 
Dates = as.Date(...)
Values1 = rbind(100, 110, ...)
Values2 = rbind(90, 85, ...)
 
output$table1 = renderText ({
    data.frame(Dates, Values1, Values2)
     })
})
 
 
Question - How do I get this to work? So far, I have not been successful in getting the desired table above....
 
Again, thanks to anyone who helps! Go, R!
